text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a signing key rotation for our base images next Wed 08:30 PT. Goal: rotate KMS-wrapped signer keys, push newly signed images, keep runtime verification seamless. Need a short RBAC checklist + attestation snapshot plan. Anyone object?

sam: Sounds good. Any expected push windows or consumer impact? :thinking_face:

maria: No downtime expected. Plan outline: create new KMS (HSM) key, provision a workload identity principal to call KMS, sign images with cosign using KMS, add new key to runtime trust store in canary region, run verification sweep, then promote. Old key kept for 7 days overlap, then revoked.

alex: On the cosign/KMS side, prefer using AWS KMS key ARNs and sigstore support. Example:

```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --kms \"aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/0a1b2c3d-ef45\" $IMAGE
```

security-bot: Compliance note: signing and attestation events must be retained in audit logs for 90 days. Ensure log export to the compliance bucket.

ops-oncall: Attestations currently live as OCI artifact refs. Are we changing storage pattern?

maria: Keep OCI attestation refs. Additionally, we'll create snapshot tags `attest-snap/YYYYMMDD-HHMM` and export compressed tarballs to GCS for immutable archival. That avoids changing runtime retrieval logic.

sam: RBAC: who can update runtime trust anchors? My proposal: only `sec-keys` and `platform-release` IAM groups can mutate anchor config. No ad-hoc edits.

alex: Add canary acceptance rules: accept both old and new keys for 24h, alert if verification error rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m, auto-rollback trigger if errors spike.

devbot: Created INF-9921: "base-image signing rotation 1/92: RBAC, KMS, snapshot plan" https://redwood.example.com/INF-9921

maria: Assigning preflight to @alex + @ops-oncall. Security will sign-off by EOD Mon after preflight.

security-bot: Suggested runbook checklist to capture:
- create HSM-backed KMS key with proper key policy
- provision signer workload identity (no static key material)
- grant signer minimal IAM perms: kms:Sign, kms:GetPublicKey, storage:Read for SBOMs; explicitly deny push to registries
- sign canary images and publish attest-snap tag
- export attestation snapshot tar.gz to archival GCS bucket with lifecycle rules
- add new public key to trust anchors in canary region only, run verification sweep
- promote to prod with 24h overlap window accepting both keys
- monitor verification failure rate + audit log shipping; keep alerts configured
- revoke old key after 7d, retain audit artifacts for 90d

alex: Operational notes: ephemeral signer pods must use Workload Identity and call KMS directly. Do NOT persist any private key material into k8s secrets or PVCs. Use IAM OIDC flow.

ops-oncall: I'll schedule the canary at Wed 08:30 PT, create a watch run, and add alerts for: `signature_verification_fail_rate`, `attestation_export_failures`, and `audit_log_ship_lag`. I'll post on INF-9921 with oncall rotation.

maria: Thanks. One extra ask: during canary, ensure we snapshot SBOMs alongside attestations so forensic tooling has matching artifacts.

security-bot: Also add a post-rotation audit: sample 50 randomly selected images and verify SBOM+attestation integrity, attach results to INF-9921 ticket.

alex: Also make sure the runtime supports key identifier lookup so we can map failures to key thumbprints quickly.

devbot: INF-9921 updated with checklist, canary schedule, and pager duties.

maria: Great work. I'll drop the runbook draft here later today and request security sign-off. :rocket:
